where: Section 3 (self weight formula) and Quiz Q4 answer
problem: The chapter defines w as a UDL intensity in kN/m everywhere, but the self-weight rule w = ρ A g with ρ in kg/m³, A in m² and g in m/s² gives N/m, not kN/m. A student using ρ = 2500 kg/m³ and A = 0.1 m² would write w = 2452.5 kN/m instead of 2.45 kN/m.
fix: Write w = ρ A g / 1000, giving w in kN/m when ρ is in kg/m³, A in m² and g = 9.81 m/s². Quiz Q4 answer should read: each metre carries ρ A g newtons, so w = ρ A g / 1000 kN/m, constant along the span.

problem: "Note that a fixed end on its own already uses up all three equations" is misleading. A fixed support does not consume equations; it supplies three unknowns, which is exactly the number a cantilever has.
fix: Say: "A cantilever has a single fixed end, which gives three unknowns — exactly the three equations, so it is determinate."

problem: "an eccentric load replaced by a force plus a moment" is given as an example of a pure couple, but that replacement produces a force and a couple together, not a pure moment.
fix: Say: "A couple has no net force. An eccentric load can be replaced by a concentric force plus a couple; only the couple part is the applied moment."
